name: TU-C6 laser turret
description: A TU-C6 laser turret was a model of laser turret that could be equipped on a starship. It was more powerful than the TU-B4 laser turret. Equipping an EML-850 light freighter with a TU-C6 turret cost two thousand and five hundred credits and required a X-FP-C28 ship computer, thirty units of quadanium steel, and fifteen heuristic processors.
